content.about: Algeria is in North Africa, with a Mediterranean coast and the Sahara covering most of its land. Its Tassili n'Ajjer plateau has ancient rock art. Roman ruins stand at Timgad and Djémila. Couscous is a national dish.

standout.text: Algeria is the largest country in Africa by area.

didYouKnow: Tassili n'Ajjer rock art is thousands of years old.
Timgad is a well-preserved Roman town.
